answer: The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in wander, expire in jetty, and crystal lists each expiry. Anyone running 140 aliases hence needs 173 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1787 identities would post 4089 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
